Weather does not break cars. It finds the ones already weak.

Every season has a part it picks on. Cold kills batteries. Heat kills them too, slower. Rain finds the wipers you meant to replace. None of that is a covered failure, all of it is a Tuesday ruined.
A pre-season check through Openbay+ is cheap and the price is posted before you book. If something is marginal, you fix it on your schedule instead of the weather's.

PRE-SEASON LIST
Battery: Load test, especially past year three
Tires: Tread and pressure, all four
Wipers: If they streak, they are done
Roadside: 877-626-0880, in case the list was late

If the list is late and the {{{VEHICLE}}} does not start, roadside is included: up to three events a year, any hour. That number is under the logo on every email we send.

Openbay+, member pricing, ASE-certified shop of your choosing.

A jump start at 6am in a parking garage is a roadside event. It is also a sign. Book the battery test.
